description: Query the BlockVectra Data API for a specified chain and path using your BlockVectra API key. For endpoint schemas and parameter specifications, see the OpenAPI contract at https://docs.blockvectra.com/openapi/data.yaml. Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration (keys must not be passed in tool parameters or chat). Returns the HTTP status and JSON response body.

path.description: Path after '/v1/data/{chain}/' (e.g. 'status/freshness', 'address/0x.../balances'). Must not start with '/', and cannot contain '..', '//', '?', '#', or '%'.

query.description: Optional URL query parameters as key-value pairs.

name: data_api_get

balance_units.description: Remaining balance units after this request (only present when balance is known and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

cu_charged.description: Compute Units billed for this request (only present when charged and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

title: Query Data API
